description: This file is a FastAPI application script that defines the backend API for a career platform. It includes setup for database models, endpoints for health checks, template management, role management, application startup routines including database creation and optional seeding, and integration of multiple API routers for different functionalities.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: A SQLAlchemy model representing user roles in the system.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A SQLAlchemy model representing template entities stored in the database.

methods.name: None on_startup()
methods.description: Initialize the database tables and seed data based on environment variables during app startup.

methods.name: dict health_check()
methods.description: Endpoint to perform a simple health check of the API service.

methods.name: TemplateOut create_template(payload: TemplateCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
List[TemplateOut] list_templates(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all templates.

methods.name: TemplateOut get_template(template_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Get a specific template by ID.

methods.name: TemplateOut update_template( template_id: int, payload: TemplateUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Update fields of an existing template.

methods.name: None delete_template(template_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
List[RoleRead] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
